calculations.text: revenue: 1248 vs 1058 (Q1 FY27 vs Q1 FY26) = +18.0% YoY
ebitda_margin: 12.9% -> 11.2% (Q1 FY27 vs Q1 FY26) = -170 bps
export_share_pct: 16% -> 21% (Q1 FY27 vs Q1 FY26) = +500 bps
Pledged shares as % of TOTAL shares (as of 30 Jun 2026) = 4.1% x 58.2% = 2.4% (the 4.1% itself is a share of the promoter holding, not of all shares)
Pledged shares as % of TOTAL shares (as of 30 Jun 2025) = 11.5% x 58.4% = 6.7% (the 11.5% itself is a share of the promoter holding, not of all shares)
Capex: 70% of 620 crore spent = 434 crore; remaining = 186 crore
Tip-sheet target 1450 vs last reported price 1012 implies +43% (the tip sheet itself claims 60%; prices are from different dates)
